who: Aris Maye is an old fortune-teller who keeps a big tent by Varrock Square and reads futures in a crystal ball for a coin. Older than anyone can work out, she knows things nobody told her, foresaw the demon Delrith's return, and once stopped time itself in Lumbridge.
notices: what the ball shows about you: your future, your fate, the sword in your hand
how young you are, which is very

values: the old heroes, Wally above all, even if history forgot him
wisdom in the young, when it turns up
